justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/history/HistoryActivity.java (165 lines) plus supporting android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/history/HistoryManager.java and HistoryItemAdapter.java. HistoryActivity contains only one private helper and a small set of UI event handlers (onCreate, onResume, onListItemClick, context menu, options menu), while the heavier history persistence/export logic is delegated to HistoryManager and row rendering to HistoryItemAdapter, so the class reads as a cohesive screen controller rather than an under-decomposed multi-responsibility class.
